Code read: MassProps.ownership sorts kept parts first, then rankOf (slot rank), then Sampling.measureRanked. Its H loop skips q when q is sameSolid to a member of H, and p owns nothing when it is sameSolid to a member of H. Sampling.ranked (the verdict) goes by volume, then the slot NAME (a.slot < b.slot), place, half extents, material name, and so on. So for a kept part and its exact copy, the one whose slot's name comes first stays kept.
